description: GenServer (OctoPi.TUI.UI) owns root component, hook-cell map keyed by hole id, invalidation set, aggregated next-frame deadline. Hook handle `h` is passed to render fns explicitly (no implicit closure-of-current-component). use_frame requests aggregate into one deadline fed to RenderLoop — components never read System.monotonic_time directly, the reconciler passes frame index in (deterministic in tests). Hook-cell GC: cells not visited this frame retained one frame, then dropped. Tests: state survives rerenders, memo invalidation triggers rerender, frame deadlines coalesce correctly, key subscriptions mount/unmount cleanly.
title: Reconciler + hooks: use_state, use_memo, use_frame, use_key, use_effect
